name: Alchemist
description:
Often mistaken for a job, the Alchemists are their own species.

There are no juveniles, and nobody has seen how they reproduce. They simply appear in dark alleys and tired laboratories, wherever a crowd of things will explode.

The mask is not a costume. Take it off and the body fails. With it on, they recycle a potion once, ignore poison, and throw a limited stock of bombs.
